title: Chiang Mai vs Chiang Rai: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Chiang Mai for variety and infrastructure, Chiang Rai for the White Temple and authentic hill tribe trekking. Do both with 4 nights CM + 2 nights CR.

categories.name: Temples & Culture
categories.summary: Chiang Rai has the White Temple, Blue Temple, and Black House — globally unique. Chiang Mai has 300+ wats.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Chiang Mai is the birthplace of khao soi and has world-class street food markets. Chiang Rai is decent but limited.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Chiang Rai is marginally cheaper — ~$20-35/day vs $25-40/day in Chiang Mai.

categories.name: Trekking
categories.summary: Closer to Myanmar border, more authentic hill tribe villages, Mae Salong tea country.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Chiang Mai has real nightlife on Nimman Road. Chiang Rai has a night market and a few bars, nothing more.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Doi Inthanon, Pai, elephant sanctuaries, and Chiang Rai itself give CM a deeper day trip radius.

categories.name: Digital Nomad
categories.summary: Chiang Mai is one of SE Asia's top nomad hubs. Chiang Rai has minimal co-working infrastructure.

categories.name: Authenticity
categories.summary: Less commercialized, more local Thai vibe. Feels like Chiang Mai 40 years ago, per Reddit travelers.

faq.question: Is Chiang Mai or Chiang Rai better for first-time Thailand travelers?
faq.answer: Chiang Mai wins for first-timers — more variety, better transport, and stronger English-speaking infrastructure.

faq.question: How far is Chiang Rai from Chiang Mai?
faq.answer: About 200 km, roughly 3-3.5 hours by bus or car. Green Bus runs for 130-170 THB (.50-).
